title: Magnetizer
pages: Craft the controller from three iron ingots, two redstone, two Flange Press-made flanged rings flanking one Wound Motor. Make the motor from two Induction Coiler-made Wound Coils, a tempered Drive Shaft, two Deep-Groove Ball Bearings and two iron ingots. The coils provide the field, iron closes its magnetic path, and the rolling bearings carry the fast-spinning rotor; a plain Sintered Bronze Bushing is rejected here. Bearing route: craft four steel billets, one chromium ingot (forge:ingots/chromium) and one coal or charcoal (minecraft:coals) into four Bearing Steel Charges, a high-carbon chromium steel, and fire each in the kiln at 900 heat for 160 ticks into Bearing Steel Stock. Swage one stock into two Bearing Race Blanks, quench two blanks in the Quench Vat into two Hardened Bearing Races, and press another stock in the Press into eight Bearing Balls. Craft two hardened races, two balls and one iron nugget (the cage) shapelessly into one bearing. Soft race blanks cannot be assembled. The kiln, vat and press accept hoppers, so only the swaging and final assembly are hand steps. Place an iron block directly beneath the controller, an observer directly above it, and target blocks on all four horizontal sides. Put an iron-bar support directly below each target: east, west, north and south of the iron base. The lower iron yoke supports the target ring around the magnetic field. Any missing or swapped target, support, cap or base stops operation. Crafting slot 1 (row-major 3x3) requires a nickel ingot via forge:ingots/nickel.

Right-click the formed controller with feedstock from a loaded magnetization recipe. It loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. It needs no FE; hand use and the automation buffer below share the same recipes.

The Magnetizer has 20 exclusive datapack recipes. Three iron and three gold tools still return ingots at a loss; the diamond pickaxe returns two diamonds. Twelve other worn iron or gold tools and armor pieces become useful hardware: iron bars, bucket, minecart, iron trapdoor, shears, cauldron, light weighted pressure plate, and five lower-cost golden tools or armor pieces. Each conversion uses a different piece of gear and does not return more metal value than went into it. The final recipe realigns three Induction Coiler Wound Coils into one Magnetized Core. JEI shows the loaded inputs, outputs, batch counts and formation requirements.

A Magnetized Core replaces the Resonance Infuser's top-right plain sealed steel plate, alongside the Wound Coil, the Charged Capacitor, the conductive crystal, one vitrified amethyst, a Resonant Rune, the harmonic lens and an electrolyzer. This is the fourth required t4 apparatus; the Arc Press's Fused Steel Plate later replaces the last bottom-left plain plate.

Automation: the controller also keeps a one-stack stock buffer and a one-stack product buffer. Hoppers, droppers and sided item pipes insert from the top and the four sides; only items that match a loaded magnetization recipe are accepted, and simulated inserts never change the buffer. While the structure is formed and owned, it runs one batch every 40 ticks (2 seconds) without power, using the same recipe priority as hand use (lowest resource ID first). Products wait in the buffer and are pulled from the bottom face, e.g. by a hopper under a Stock Hatch that replaces the base part. If the structure breaks, work pauses and progress resets; if the product buffer is full or holds a different item, work waits. Sneak-use with an empty hand on a face to cycle it between In, Out and Off; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered products. Buffers, progress and face settings are saved with the chunk, and breaking the controller drops both buffers.

Stock Hatches: every face of this controller is covered by a frame part, so hoppers and pipes reach it through Stock Hatches. Place a hatch instead of any part that touches the controller face-to-face; at most two hatches may stand in, and a third breaks formation. A hatch relays only while the frame is formed, and it relays the controller face it covers: insert stock into a hatch on an In face, and extract products from a hatch whose face you sneak-use with an empty hand to cycle to Out (the base face starts as Out). For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
